marta: FYI Acadia is getting repeated 429s during SDK prefetch in CI. They run ~48 parallel runners with prefetch=true.

alex: Is this at rollout start?

marta: Yes. CI logs: ```[INFO] prefetch: requesting ephemeral token
[WARN] 429 Too Many Requests - /v1/ephemeral_tokens (x9)
[DEBUG] retry in 150ms
[DEBUG] retry in 180ms
[ERROR] retries exhausted after 5 attempts```

devon: Thundering herd. Likely simultaneous token requests. Do they use default backoff?

marta: Default. They enabled prefetch to reduce cold starts.

alex: Short-term: request infra burst; advise client atomic single-flight fetch + jitter; or flip prefetch off and stage rollout. Which now?

marta: They want minimal downtime. Please open a burst request and send a quick client patch.

ratebot: [alert] tenant acadia-corp ephemeral_token rate spike detected: 11x baseline. Auto-throttle engaged.

alex: Opening BR. Requesting 5x burst for 15m. Tagging infra-oncall.

alex: BR-9810 opened.

infra-oncall: Acknowledge. We can carve a tenant-specific exception for 10-12 minutes if needed.

devon: Client patch (single-flight + jitter): ```js
let pending=null; async function getToken(){ if(pending) return pending; pending=(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<6;i++){ try{return await requestToken(); }catch(e){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, Math.floor(Math.random()*200)+(2**i)*80)); }} throw new Error('token fetch failed'); })(); try{return await pending;}finally{pending=null;}}```

marta: Sending that plus advice to stagger runner starts by hashing build id across runners to spread starts ~30s. Also ask them to flip prefetch off if issues persist.

infra-oncall: BR-9810 update: applied a tenant-scoped burst x4 for 12 minutes. Monitoring.

ratebot: [update] BR-9810 applied for acadia-corp.

alex: Capture this in CS playbook: "prefetch stampede during onboarding" with mitigation steps and when to request infra burst. Marta, can you draft?

marta: Will draft and add to onboarding runbook, include CI config and postmortem after rollout.

devon: Ops note: consider adding Retry-After with a small jitter on ephemeral endpoints to reduce synchronized retries. I'll draft an RFC.

marta: Thanks all, I'll update Acadia and report back in ~40m. :thumbsup:
